text:
alex: Morning — quick async: what I did yesterday: finished route-pruner prototype and validated on staging; ran a prefix-caching spike, saw ~12% token reduction. Blocker: can't reproduce a rare 503 coming from dedupe-proxy. Today: pair with Jamal on rate-policy tests and send CR for pruner. ping @sasha for auth token rotation plan?
jamal: Nice. I can pair after lunch. For the 503s — can you paste the log snippet? I suspect kv-cache eviction race.
alex: here's the quick grep I ran locally: `kubectl logs -n gw svc/dedupe -c proxy | grep "503" -A3` — shows eviction + retry loop.
sasha: @alex re: token rotation — rolling window starts 2025-03-12 02:00 UTC. We need services to accept old tokens for ~6h. Eng-platform will manage the rollout flag; I'll push it this afternoon. :thumbsup:
maria: Quick heads-up — I left comments on PR #1234 (route-pruner) about metric names and a tiny race when config reloads. Not blocking but worth addressing.
jamal: Will check the CR. Also, can we throttle internal test traffic? My local sim hit the RPS cap and tripped the canary; I'd like a test token that bypasses quota for staging.
sasha: Do not bypass quotas in prod. Instead: create a low-privilege test token scope and route test clients to a dedicated test pool. That keeps semantics but avoids blowing prod quotas.
alex: Ack. Jamal — please open a brief RFC (one paragraph + config snippet) for the test-token scope in your PR description.
deploy-bot: deploy started for canary/gateway-1 at 6888001300 — 1/3 hosts healthy.
maria: FYI — saw a short spike of 429s during the baseline run at ~02:10 UTC. Correlates with an unexpected jump in batch size; I'm investigating.
jamal: Maybe the batching heuristic is too aggressive for short-sequence workloads. Lowering max_batch_size to 32 helped in my local run.
alex: If we lower globally it increases cost. Suggest per-route override: route.policy.max_batch=32 for short-seq routes. I'll draft a config PR for that.
sasha: Also check auth middleware: if token verification times out we return 401, but there is a small path that maps errors to 503. I'm opening a fix in auth middleware (ticket #207) to ensure timeouts yield 401 and are instrumented.
maria: Blocking task for me today — add a tracing span around KV eviction so we can link evictions to 503 traces.
alex: Summary / next steps: Jamal/join after lunch to pair on rate-policy tests; Jamal open RFC for test-token; Alex will draft per-route override + CR; Sasha will push rotation flag and fix mapping in auth middleware; Maria will add tracing span for KV eviction. Ping here if you get stuck. :coffee:
